name: Orange Zest
siboNotes: Orange zest is naturally FODMAP-free and provides citrus oils that may have mild antimicrobial properties beneficial for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Use only the colored outer layer, avoiding the bitter white pith
Wash oranges thoroughly before zesting to remove any residues
Fresh zest provides the best flavor and aroma
Store dried zest in an airtight container for up to 6 months
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and citrus bioflavonoids
